name: TextField
description: Single-line text entry field with label. Icon (none / leading / trailing), State (default / active / disabled), Feedback (default / invalid / message), independently combinable except disabled+invalid.
rules: Don't set disabled together with invalid.
Leading icon = input context (search, email); trailing icon = actions (clear, toggle).
message = persistent guidance; invalid only after failed validation.
invalid replaces message — never show both.
